statement: Release 11.8 is primarily a field-research workflow and spatial-operations release. It does not change the Mechanistic Maize Twin, multimodal crop models, causal estimators or decision-intelligence mathematical methods. It adds explicit rule-persistence logic, structured observation/operation provenance and conservative exploratory spatial clustering semantics.

new_methods_or_semantics.alert_persistence: Consecutive threshold evaluations plus cooldown are persisted per field/rule before a new alert incident is generated.
new_methods_or_semantics.observation_protocols: Reusable measurement definitions with quantitative values linked to field/trial/experimental-unit/plant context.
new_methods_or_semantics.spatial_operation_support: Actual/planned operation records may carry a whole-field or contained custom polygon; spatial support is not causal effect evidence.
new_methods_or_semantics.exploratory_multivariate_zoning: StandardScaler + optional PCA + KMeans + silhouette on georeferenced point measurements. Results remain exploratory point clusters unless additional spatial interpolation and validation are supplied.
new_methods_or_semantics.sampling_designs: Systematic, random and stratified-random point designs are generated inside authoritative field geometry and can be persisted.
